concepts.prompt: Using the reference images for palette and style, draft a 3D-model concept of a wooden roadside barrier post whose rope was cut: a stout square weathered timber post about 1.8 m tall with a chamfered top cap, a small stone footing, a dark iron band and a big iron ring bolted near the top. A thick tan hemp rope is still tied to the iron ring but cut short: the rope hangs down about 70 cm and ends in a clearly frayed, splayed, unravelled cut end. Warm wood browns, tan rope, dark iron. No red, no oxblood. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game prop, chunky exaggerated readable silhouette that reads clearly from 15 m away, hand-painted PBR look, clean shapes, slightly oversized details. Single isolated object, full object visible and centred, plain neutral background, even lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text.
